descriptions.approach: The approach is to use a set of free online tools to predict the substance's properties, and to compare the results to experimental data from a set of known substances. The tools are evaluated based on their accuracy and the type of calculations they use.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of properties related to a compound's behavior in biological systems is estimated, including its likelihood of being safe, metabolized efficiently, and avoiding harmful interactions, using available experimental results from known compounds.
descriptions.approach: A systematic evaluation is performed by testing 18 distinct computational methods on a group of known compounds, comparing their outputs against known outcomes, and assessing consistency, reliability, and predictive performance across different conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: General medicine interns’ attitude in continuing their education in emergency medicine residency programs

descriptions.problem: A group of healthcare trainees is assessed for their interest in pursuing a specialized, high-pressure clinical role involving urgent patient care. The level of interest is measured across various personal and situational factors, including financial considerations and prior training background.
descriptions.approach: A structured survey is administered to trainees, collecting self-reported preferences and motivations. Responses are aggregated and analyzed to identify patterns, with statistical comparisons made across demographic and background variables to detect influencing factors.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the level of interest in pursuing a specialized field among individuals who have recently completed a training program, and compares this interest across different demographic groups. It also identifies the factors that influence this interest.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a survey to collect data from a large group of individuals, and analyzed this data using statistical software to identify patterns and correlations. The results were then compared to identify trends and influences.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

topic_name: Parasitic infections in humans and animals
title: Diagnostic and Management Perspectives in Alveolar Echinococcosis: Review of Literature

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate the likelihood of a life-threatening condition caused by a parasite, which can lead to death within 10 years if left untreated. It compares the effectiveness of different medical tests and imaging methods to identify the condition.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves combining patient medical history, imaging findings, and test results to make an educated prediction about the presence of the condition. The goal is to optimize early detection and treatment of the condition, especially in cases with cystic growths.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the likelihood of a chronic, slowly progressing condition based on clinical history, imaging patterns, and biological test results, especially when lesions appear in a specific organ.
descriptions.approach: The system integrates historical data, visual patterns from scans, and lab markers to evaluate risk, prioritizing early detection when symptoms are absent and the condition mimics benign growths.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

topic_name: Fibromyalgia and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome Research
title: In Memory of Professor Derek Pheby.

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of different treatments for a group of patients with a chronic illness, comparing the outcomes of various interventions. It aims to identify the most effective approach.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from patient records and medical literature to develop a model that predicts treatment outcomes. They then tested this model on a new dataset to validate its accuracy.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the likelihood of a chronic condition worsening over time based on patient-reported symptoms and longitudinal health records.
descriptions.approach: It uses a statistical model that adjusts predictions by weighting recent symptom changes and medical history, then compares outcomes across individuals with similar profiles to identify patterns of progression.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Resolving equivocal gain modulation of corticospinal excitability

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the optimal timing of a response to a stimulus, and compares the results to predictions made based on the timing of the stimulus. It also optimizes the analysis of the response to avoid errors.
descriptions.approach: The researchers applied a specific type of stimulation to a part of the brain, and then analyzed the response in a different part of the body. They used a technique to filter out errors and get a more accurate measurement of the response.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The pattern of how a system's response changes with the timing of a stimulus is estimated across different phases of a rhythmic cycle, and discrepancies in this pattern are identified as potential artifacts in data processing.
descriptions.approach: A stimulus is delivered at varying times relative to a measured rhythm, and the resulting output amplitude is recorded. The analysis uses broad-band processing to isolate true timing effects, avoiding distortions introduced by narrow-band filtering.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A Rare Case of Pancreatic Actinomyces

descriptions.problem: This work identifies a rare case where a certain type of bacteria, commonly found in the digestive system, causes a mass in a specific organ, mimicking a serious disease. It estimates the presence of this bacteria and its impact on the organ.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used imaging tests to detect the mass, took a sample from it, and then treated the patient with antibiotics. They followed up to see if the mass resolved, and their findings emphasize the importance of considering alternative explanations for the mass.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of persistent symptoms is observed alongside a detectable mass in a bodily region, and the likelihood of a noninvasive, slow-growing microbial infection is assessed against the possibility of a rapidly progressing, destructive process.
descriptions.approach: A diagnostic procedure involves analyzing tissue samples for microbial presence and evaluating clinical history for risk factors, then comparing findings to known patterns of infection and disease progression over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Evaluation of the Digital Elevation Model from the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) on the Papaloapan Macro-Basin, Mexico, using LiDAR as benchmark

descriptions.problem: This work estimates and compares the accuracy of a digital map of the Earth's surface in a specific region, using a more precise map as a benchmark. It aims to identify areas where the map is less accurate and to suggest ways to improve it.
descriptions.approach: The work uses a precise map as a benchmark to compare the accuracy of a digital map. It then analyzes the errors and identifies patterns to suggest ways to improve the map, such as calibration or combining multiple sources.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A spatial model's accuracy is assessed against a high-resolution reference dataset across diverse terrain types, measuring deviations in elevation values and analyzing how these errors relate to landscape features and orientation.
descriptions.approach: Elevation differences are computed across regions with distinct surface characteristics. Error patterns are mapped and grouped by terrain type, slope direction, and elevation bands to identify consistent biases and propose simple adjustments for improvement.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Chiplet Placement for 2.5D IC with Sequence Pair Based Tree and Thermal Consideration

descriptions.problem: This work aims to find the most efficient way to connect components in a complex system, taking into account the heat generated by these connections. It estimates the minimum amount of material needed to connect the components, and compares it to a baseline.
descriptions.approach: The approach uses a tree-like structure to represent the connections, and a method to prune branches that are unlikely to be the most efficient. It then uses a technique to optimize the connections and reduce the heat generated.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the best arrangement of interconnected components on a shared substrate to minimize signal path lengths while managing heat buildup that could degrade performance.
descriptions.approach: It builds a hierarchical structure from component interactions, evaluates arrangements through recursive pruning, and adjusts the layout based on heat propagation models to balance efficiency and thermal stability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Modeling Soil Organic Carbon at Coastal Sabkhas with Different Vegetation Covers at the Red Sea Coast of Saudi Arabia

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the distribution of a certain type of organic matter in the ground, comparing different models to see which one fits the data best. It also predicts the total amount of this organic matter in the ground.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from 1250 samples to train three different models: one that uses a curve to fit the data, one that uses a curve to predict the total amount, and one that uses a different curve to predict the total amount. The best model was chosen based on how well it fit the data.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern in the vertical accumulation of a key material is estimated across different environmental conditions, using measurements taken at multiple locations. The pattern is predicted and compared across distinct land cover types to determine which function best represents how the material builds up with depth.
descriptions.approach: A set of mathematical functions is applied to depth-based measurements to model how a material accumulates over time. The function that best fits the observed data across conditions is selected based on statistical accuracy and consistency in prediction.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Identification and Valuation of Economic Activities Reserves as a Priorityin Strategic Analysis

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the potential value of a business's resources based on market demand, competition, supplier and customer availability, and financial indicators. It compares different methods to calculate this value and optimizes the approach to ensure the business's long-term sustainability.
descriptions.approach: The work uses a combination of direct evaluation, comparison, and mathematical programming to identify and estimate the value of the business's resources. It classifies resources into different categories and applies various methods to calculate their value.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the extent to which an organization can sustain or enhance its operations beyond current capacity by leveraging untapped capabilities, based on market demand, supplier reliability, customer behavior, and financial support.
descriptions.approach: The system evaluates potential operational flexibility by comparing current performance to historical patterns and external conditions, using statistical and optimization models to assign weights to different factors and predict outcomes under varying conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: An advanced molecular medicine case report of a rare human tumor using genomics, pathomics, and radiomics

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the characteristics of a rare lung disease, compares its features to those of other diseases, and optimizes a treatment plan based on the findings. It aims to explain the underlying causes and behavior of the disease.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a combination of DNA and RNA analyses to identify the underlying causes of the disease. It also uses imaging data and software tools to analyze and compare the disease's characteristics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A detailed biological profile of a rare lung condition is constructed by analyzing genetic variants, gene activity patterns, and imaging-derived features to identify key drivers and suppressive mechanisms.
descriptions.approach: Genetic and expression data from tissue samples are combined with quantitative features extracted from medical images. A unified computational framework integrates and validates these data streams to detect consistent patterns and generate a predictive biological model.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Evaluating the effect of phytoameliorative measures on the land reclamation status

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the effect of growing certain plants on the amount of salt in the soil, and compare it to uncultivated fields. It also tries to predict the amount of salt that will be leached from the soil during different seasons.
descriptions.approach: The researchers planted two types of plants and monitored the amount of salt in the soil over time. They compared the results to the amount of salt in uncultivated fields and calculated the difference in salt leaching rates.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The effect of introducing specific crop species on soil salinity reduction is estimated by comparing salt leaching volumes and soil salt concentration changes over time across different land management scenarios.
descriptions.approach: Soil and water data are collected over a growing season, and salt movement and soil accumulation are tracked. A comparison is made between cropped and uncropped plots to determine how crop presence alters the rate and extent of salt removal from the soil profile.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: 20 Best Tweets of All Time About Maxine Moseley Skin Clinics

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of various beauty treatments, predicts the outcomes of combining different treatments, and compares the results of different treatments to explain their benefits. It also optimizes the choice of treatment for individual users.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves analyzing data on the outcomes of different treatments, using a combination of non-invasive methods and expert advice to make predictions and comparisons. The procedure follows a step-by-step process of selecting treatments, evaluating their outcomes, and making recommendations for individual users.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of treatments is evaluated for their effectiveness in improving appearance and user satisfaction based on observed outcomes and reported experiences from individuals who have undergone them.
descriptions.approach: A structured sequence of procedures is applied, each designed to remove surface layers, stimulate renewal, and deliver hydration, with combinations tested to determine optimal outcomes for different user profiles.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Why we should teach the History of Ukrainian art to students of Art Schools

descriptions.problem: This research aims to explain the importance of studying the past development of a particular cultural phenomenon, which was shaped by interactions with other cultures, and to correct common misconceptions about its place in the broader cultural landscape.
descriptions.approach: The researcher uses a comparative approach, analyzing the cultural phenomenon in question alongside other similar phenomena from different cultural contexts, and presenting the findings in a way that avoids oversimplification or bias.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of creative development is analyzed across distinct cultural and political contexts, aiming to reveal how local practices are shaped by and interact with broader regional and international influences.
descriptions.approach: A comparative framework is applied to examine how artistic expressions emerge from specific historical and social conditions, integrating diverse influences while maintaining contextual integrity and avoiding oversimplified narratives.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Financial Crises as a Phenomenon of Multiple Equilibria and How to Select among Them

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the likelihood of multiple stable states in a complex system, and compares their relative merits. It aims to explain how to select the most desirable state from these multiple options.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using a mathematical model to simulate the system's behavior and evaluate the stability of each potential state. The model follows a procedure that considers the interactions and responses of the system's components.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system where multiple stable outcomes can emerge is studied to determine which outcome is likely to occur under real-world decision-making conditions.
descriptions.approach: A rule-based process simulates how agents update their actions based on direct observation of others' choices, leading to a self-reinforcing pattern that naturally evolves toward one stable state over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Robust Pseudo-Markets for Reusable Public Resources

descriptions.problem: A system allocates a shared resource to multiple users over time, where each user wants to use it for a continuous period and gains value only if they receive the full period. The goal is to ensure each user receives a predictable fraction of their maximum possible benefit, regardless of how others act.
descriptions.approach: Each user starts with a fixed amount of virtual tokens representing their expected share. On each turn, users submit a request for a continuous period and a value for each unit of time. The one with the highest value for that period is granted access, with a minimum threshold ensuring fairness and stability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the fair share of resources that each agent should receive, and optimizes the allocation of these resources over multiple rounds. It compares the agents' ideal utilities to their actual utilities, and shows that a certain mechanism can guarantee that each agent receives at least half of their ideal utility.
descriptions.approach: The mechanism uses a first-price auction with a selective reserve, where each agent submits their desired use and a per-round offer. The agent with the highest offer wins and gets to use the resource for their desired amount.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Economic mechanism of land use in European countries in conditions of sustainable development

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the relationship between land use and sustainable development in European countries, comparing indicators such as land area, land per person, and land prices across different countries. It aims to explain how changes in land prices will impact the formation of a transparent land market.
descriptions.approach: The study groups European countries by land ownership and land price levels, then compares these groups to identify trends and patterns in land use and development.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of resource allocation across regions is analyzed to understand how land value and usage influence long-term planning decisions in diverse settings.
descriptions.approach: Regions are grouped by the cost of accessing land per unit area. Trends in land value and usage are compared across groups to identify how pricing affects distribution and policy outcomes over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Wind turbine power control

descriptions.problem: This work aims to optimize the performance of a system that converts energy from a natural source into a usable form. It estimates the optimal settings for this system based on various environmental factors.
descriptions.approach: The system uses a mathematical model to simulate different scenarios and find the best settings. It then compares the results to real-world data to validate its findings.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system adjusts the orientation of a rotating component in response to environmental conditions to maintain stable output performance across varying input forces and flow directions.
descriptions.approach: The system continuously monitors input dynamics and applies real-time adjustments to a mechanical parameter to align output with operational constraints and external variability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A simple procedure for the non-linear optimization of cable tension for suspended bridges

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the optimal force distribution in a network of connected structures to support a heavy load, taking into account the redundancy of the system and the influence of non-linear effects on the structure's behavior.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using a simplified method to calculate the forces and comparing the results to those obtained from a more complex computer simulation, which is widely used in engineering practice.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system of interconnected members transfers loads through rigid joints, and the forces within them are adjusted to maintain structural stability under real-world deformations. The goal is to find the best force distribution that balances internal stresses and external loads across the structure.
descriptions.approach: A step-by-step iterative rule updates force values based on observed displacements and known geometry. Each iteration adjusts forces until the resulting deformations match those predicted by a detailed physical simulation of the entire system.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Results of the Introduction (1970-2017) of Roses and Their Breeding In the Central Botanical Garden

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of introducing and selecting 575 species of a specific type of flowering plant over a period of 47 years, comparing the results to the original species. It aims to explain the outcome of this process.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a process of trial and error, selecting and breeding the plants to create new ones, and then evaluated their characteristics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of plant lineages is tracked over time to evaluate changes in their physical and aesthetic traits following controlled breeding and environmental exposure.
descriptions.approach: A structured process is applied to select and propagate lineages based on consistent trait expression, using repeated observations and environmental conditions to refine and document outcomes across generations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Possible renoprotective mechanisms of SGLT2 inhibitors

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of a certain class of medications on patients with a specific disease, and compares it to the effect of a different class of medications. It also tries to explain why this effect occurs.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use data from previous studies to identify the mechanisms behind the effect of these medications. They follow a procedure that involves analyzing changes in blood pressure, nerve activity, and other physiological measures to understand the underlying biological processes.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A biological process is investigated to explain how a drug-induced state reduces tissue damage under stress conditions, despite no direct changes in metabolic fuel availability or blood pressure.
descriptions.approach: A model proposes that the body activates a conserved survival mechanism in response to metabolic scarcity, involving changes in vascular function, local growth signals, and reduced oxidative stress to preserve tissue integrity during prolonged stress.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Study on Hydrogeological Problems in Engineering Geological Investigation

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate the risks associated with construction projects by analyzing the properties of the ground and its impact on the project's stability and safety. It compares the effects of various ground conditions on the project's success.
descriptions.approach: The study uses data from construction sites to analyze the properties of the ground and its impact on the project's stability and safety. It proposes effective measures to minimize risks and optimize the project's success.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The system estimates how underground water movement affects structural stability and project risk during early development stages, using observations from subsurface conditions and environmental signals.
descriptions.approach: It analyzes patterns in water flow through different soil layers and evaluates how changes in moisture levels influence ground behavior, adjusting predictions based on real-time environmental inputs and historical site behavior.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A selective literature review exploring the role of the nicotinic system in schizophrenia

descriptions.problem: A pattern of behavior is assessed across multiple studies to determine whether exposure to a substance correlates with symptom reduction or disease progression in individuals with a known condition.
descriptions.approach: A systematic evaluation of research findings is conducted, filtering only those that report direct or indirect links between substance use and clinical outcomes, then analyzing consistency and strength of reported associations across diverse sources.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the relationship between a certain substance and a specific condition, comparing the prevalence of the substance in people with that condition to those without it. It also explores whether the substance has a beneficial or harmful effect on the condition.
descriptions.approach: The researchers review existing data and studies to understand the connection between the substance and the condition, focusing on whether the substance causes or contributes to the condition.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: O-51 Occupational exposure to triazole fungicides and risk of prostate cancer in the AGRIculture and CANcer (AGRICAN) cohort

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the risk of a serious health problem (a type of disease) in people who have been exposed to certain chemicals used in agriculture, and compares the risk to that of people who have not been exposed. It also tries to explain why some people may be more or less likely to develop this disease.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data on people's exposure to these chemicals over many years, and then used a mathematical model to calculate the risk of developing the disease. They also used statistical methods to analyze the data and identify patterns.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of health outcomes is assessed across individuals based on their exposure history to specific chemical agents used in agricultural practices, evaluating whether prolonged or repeated contact correlates with changes in disease risk over time.
descriptions.approach: Exposure durations and frequencies are mapped to known chemical agents using a crop-specific exposure model. Risk associations are estimated through statistical modeling that adjusts for time and other factors, then refined by combining exposure intensity with duration to compute cumulative exposure scores.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Data Ensemble Model for Prediction of Oxygen Content in Gas fired Boiler for Efficient Combustion

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the amount of oxygen present in a system that affects the efficiency of a process, which in turn reduces the release of harmful substances into the environment. The goal is to improve the accuracy of this estimation using a combination of data and a predictive model.
descriptions.approach: A predictive model is used to analyze images of a system under different conditions, and the results are compared to test data to determine the oxygen content. The model is trained on a dataset of images and their corresponding oxygen levels.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the concentration of a key gas in a dynamic environment by analyzing visual patterns from real-time images under varying operational conditions.
descriptions.approach: A layered deep learning model processes image sequences, learns from both labeled and unlabeled data, and combines multiple network predictions to refine the final output value with high precision.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Evaluating the Outcome of Uterine Artery Embolization in the Treatment of Submucosal Fibroid Disease

descriptions.problem: This study aims to determine the effectiveness of a specific medical procedure in alleviating symptoms in individuals with a particular type of growth in the uterus, and to identify any potential complications. It seeks to compare the outcomes of this procedure with other available treatments.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used existing data from previous treatments to evaluate the results of the procedure, comparing the effectiveness of the procedure in different groups of individuals. They followed a specific procedure to analyze the data and draw conclusions about the procedure's efficacy.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The effectiveness of a minimally invasive intervention is assessed in individuals with a specific type of benign tissue growth that affects reproductive function and causes recurrent symptoms.
descriptions.approach: A statistical model analyzes pre- and post-treatment records to compare symptom frequency, diagnostic imaging results, and clinical outcomes, adjusting for known risk factors and baseline conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Invariants of a mapping of a set to the two-dimensional Euclidean space

descriptions.problem: This work estimates and predicts the existence of certain transformations that map a set to a two-dimensional plane, and compares and optimizes these transformations based on the properties of the group of orthogonal transformations.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using a mathematical model to describe these transformations, which follow a specific procedure: the model uses a set of elements and a two-dimensional plane, and applies a set of rules to determine the relationships between these elements and the transformations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of points is transformed into a plane arrangement, and the goal is to determine if two such arrangements can be aligned through a combination of rotations, reflections, translations, and uniform scaling.
descriptions.approach: For each arrangement, compute a set of numerical values derived from distances and angles between points, then compare these values across arrangements to determine if they can be made identical through rigid or affine transformations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Deep learning based deep-sea automatic image enhancement and animal species classification

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the quality of low-quality images of underwater creatures and classifies them into species. It compares the results to original, unenhanced images and optimizes the classification accuracy.
descriptions.approach: The approach uses a complex computer model to generate improved images from raw images, and then uses another model to classify the improved images into species. The model follows a procedure of training on a dataset, generating enhanced images, and then classifying the enhanced images into species.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the type of organism in underwater footage from low-quality visual inputs, using patterns in pixel intensity and spatial structure to assign labels with high confidence.
descriptions.approach: A neural network processes raw visual data by learning to adjust brightness, contrast, and texture to improve clarity, then classifies each frame by recognizing consistent patterns across repeated image sequences.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Pseudo-noise active pulse compression thermography and multispectral imaging of the Raffaellino del Colle Sacra famiglia con San Giovanni Battista during painting restoration

descriptions.problem: This work aims to extract hidden information about the layers beneath a painting without damaging it, using a low-power energy source to avoid altering the artwork. It also seeks to understand the layering structure of the artwork.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a technique that combines data analysis and signal processing to gain insight into the hidden layers. They applied this method to a painting during restoration, using data from the painting's temperature changes.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The structure and depth of layered materials beneath a surface are inferred from temperature responses induced by controlled energy input, aiming to map subsurface layers without damaging the surface.
descriptions.approach: A sequence of controlled energy pulses is applied to a surface, and the resulting temporal and spectral responses are analyzed to extract subsurface features through time-based and frequency-based signal processing.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Genetic characterization and phylogenetic analysis of foot and mouth disease virus vaccine strains and recent field isolate

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the genetic characteristics of a virus from animal samples, compares these characteristics to those of previously known virus samples, and optimizes a new virus sample for use in a control program. It aims to determine the genetic variation between different virus samples.
descriptions.approach: The research uses a combination of laboratory tests and computer analyses to compare the genetic characteristics of the virus samples. It follows a procedure of extracting genetic information from the virus samples, comparing this information to that of previously known samples, and using this comparison to optimize the new virus sample.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A biological agent's genetic sequence is analyzed to determine its relationship to known reference sequences, assessing how much it has diverged in key regions that influence immune recognition.
descriptions.approach: DNA sequences are extracted and aligned to known variants. Differences in specific protein-coding segments are computed to build a tree showing evolutionary distances. A new version is developed based on the most divergent features found in the field sample.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Analisa Strategi Implementasi Green Computing pada ITS NU Sriwijaya Sumatera Selatan

descriptions.problem: A set of actions is designed to reduce energy consumption in daily operations by evaluating internal and external factors affecting efficiency and sustainability.
descriptions.approach: A structured framework analyzes existing capabilities and external conditions to identify effective interventions, such as extending device lifespan, consolidating operations, shifting to remote access models, and improving staff expertise through targeted development programs.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This research aims to identify and develop strategies to reduce the environmental impact of using Information and Communication Technology (ICT) devices in educational settings. It estimates the effectiveness of various strategies to achieve a more sustainable approach.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a SWOT analysis to evaluate the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and risks of using ICT devices on campus. They developed strategies to optimize the use of ICT devices, such as increasing the use of long-lasting devices and virtualization.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Systematical Characterization of the AT-Hook Gene Family in Juglans regia L. and the Functional Analysis of the JrAHL2 in Flower Induction and Hypocotyl Elongation

descriptions.problem: This work identifies and characterizes a family of proteins that help control plant growth and development, specifically flower induction and stem length. It estimates the number of proteins in this family, predicts their functions, and compares their expression in different tissues.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use evolutionary analysis to group these proteins into categories, and then study their expression patterns and subcellular localization to understand their roles in plant development.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of regulatory proteins is characterized across a plant species, with attention to their expression patterns in specific tissues and under stress conditions, and their role in developmental timing and growth regulation.
descriptions.approach: Proteins are grouped by evolutionary relationships and mapped to functional regions in the genome. Their activity is inferred from expression data and subcellular positioning, and their impact on development is tested through overexpression in a model organism.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Influence processes of seagrass degradation and restoration on sediment organic carbon storage

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the impact of human activities and global climate change on the storage of a valuable resource in coastal ecosystems. It compares the effects of degradation and restoration on this resource, and predicts the future trends.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a systematic review of existing research to understand the processes and mechanisms involved. It follows a procedure that involves analyzing data on the resource's storage, degradation, and restoration, and developing a technical system for restoration based on the findings.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is estimated that tracks how environmental stressors and recovery efforts affect the long-term retention of carbon in coastal ecosystems, particularly under changing human and climatic pressures.
descriptions.approach: A model integrates stressor impacts and recovery indicators to simulate how ecosystem structure and function influence carbon retention, using field observations and restoration metrics to predict outcomes under multiple interacting disturbances.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Chapter 4.2 Effect of reinforcement particle size on LM-13-snail shell ash–SiC hybrid metal matrix composite

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the effect of varying the size of a natural material on the mechanical and wear properties of a metal alloy. It predicts how different sizes of this material will influence the alloy's performance.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a combination of experiments and analysis to compare and contrast the properties of two metal alloys reinforced with different sizes of a natural material. The results are based on data from microstructural, mechanical, and wear tests on the samples.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The strength and durability of a metal base material are evaluated under varying reinforcement scale sizes to determine how size affects performance under load and friction.
descriptions.approach: A systematic variation in reinforcement particle dimensions is introduced, and the resulting material behavior is measured across multiple mechanical and surface interaction tests to identify optimal size for enhanced performance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Data Complexity for Identifying Suitable Algorithms

descriptions.problem: The task is to estimate the suitability of a job for a given set of tasks, based on the characteristics of the two types of tasks. This helps to choose the most efficient approach to complete the job.
descriptions.approach: A procedure is followed to categorize the tasks into simple, medium, or complex types, based on how well they can be separated. This categorization helps to identify the most suitable approach for each type of task.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A measure is estimated to assess how easily two groups of observations can be distinguished using simple boundary rules, guiding the selection of a model based on the structure of the underlying patterns in the data.
descriptions.approach: A numerical score is computed from the spread and overlap of observation values across different features. Models are then evaluated based on performance across different levels of this score to identify which perform best under varying structural conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Hot extruded Al5SiC-graphite composites: Effect of graphite on microstructure, flexural, compressive and wear resistance behavior

descriptions.problem: This work investigates how adding a certain type of material to a mixture affects its properties. It estimates and compares the effects of this material on the mixture's strength, weight loss, and friction coefficient.
descriptions.approach: The researchers created a mixture by combining the material with a base material and then tested its properties. They used a process to shape the mixture into rods and analyzed its properties using various tests.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A material's resistance to deformation under load and its performance under sliding contact are evaluated across different reinforcement levels and processing conditions.
descriptions.approach: A continuous process shapes powder-based material into a dense form. The resulting structure's internal arrangement and performance under stress and wear are analyzed through repeated testing under controlled conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Advances in extraction and purification of citrus flavonoids

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of various methods for extracting and isolating active compounds from a specific type of food, and compares their results to identify the most efficient approach. It also explains the characteristics of these compounds and proposes new research directions.
descriptions.approach: The work follows a systematic procedure: it reviews and summarizes existing research on the extraction and isolation of these compounds, explains their characteristics and proposed separation strategies, and describes the technical systems used for extraction and isolation.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A method is developed to separate and isolate complex natural compounds from a biological matrix based on their chemical structure and solubility properties, using available physical and chemical conditions to enhance yield and purity.
descriptions.approach: A stepwise process applies solvent-based techniques and selective binding agents to partition components, followed by iterative refinement using physical separation principles like filtration, distillation, or chromatographic interaction.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Detection and Classification of Pneumonia Using Deep Learning by the Dense Net-121 Model

descriptions.problem: The task is to estimate the presence of a serious illness that can be life-threatening if not identified and treated promptly, based on a visual representation of the body's condition. This is done to provide timely treatment and improve patient outcomes.
descriptions.approach: A complex model is used to analyze the visual representation, and it is trained on a large dataset of examples to learn the patterns and characteristics of the illness. The model then makes a prediction about the presence of the illness based on the visual representation.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the likelihood of a disease state from visual patterns in medical images, distinguishing between normal and abnormal conditions based on subtle structural differences.
descriptions.approach: A neural network processes image data through multiple layers of feature extraction, learning hierarchical patterns to classify patterns as normal or abnormal with high precision and consistency across diverse inputs.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Study on Characteristics and Constituent Elements of Learning Plan from the Perspective of Deep Learning

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the effectiveness of a learning plan in promoting deep learning, predicts the impact of different design elements on student outcomes, compares the results of various approaches to learning plan design, optimizes the learning process by identifying the most effective elements, and explains the underlying principles of deep learning.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a framework that combines learning objectives, knowledge structure, problem design, scenario creation, reflection, and evaluation to create a logical process for deep learning. The approach follows a problem-oriented guide with an ideological development purpose.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A structured process is inferred from observed patterns in how individuals engage with complex tasks over time, aiming to identify key components that drive meaningful engagement and long-term retention of core ideas.
descriptions.approach: A sequence of stages is constructed, each built on prior experience and guided by real-world scenarios, where goals, challenges, and feedback loops are iteratively refined to support deeper understanding and adaptive response.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Study of Succession Processes on Frozen Lignin-containing Sediments of OAO "Baikal Pulp and Paper Mill" and Soils Obtained on the Basis thereof

descriptions.problem: The rate and pattern of biological community development on degraded surfaces are monitored over time to assess how diversity and stability evolve under consistent environmental conditions.
descriptions.approach: A long-term observation system tracks changes in plant species composition and soil chemical properties, using standardized thresholds to determine when ecological stability is achieved.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the efficiency of using frozen deposits from an industrial process to improve the growth of plants on degraded land over a four-year period. It compares the changes in plant diversity and chemical composition of the deposits to a set of standards.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a four-year experiment to analyze the dynamics of plant growth and chemical changes in the deposits. They followed a procedure that involved monitoring the changes in plant diversity and chemical composition over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: (108) Risk Factors for Reinterventions, Complications, and Infections after Inflatable Penile Prosthesis: A Propensity-Matched Study

descriptions.problem: This study aims to identify the factors that increase the risk of needing to fix or replace a device implanted in men to improve their ability to get an erection, and to compare the rates of this risk in different groups of men.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a large database of real-time data from many healthcare organizations around the world to analyze the data and identify patterns. They matched the data to ensure that the groups being compared were similar in terms of certain characteristics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A statistical model estimates the likelihood of a medical device requiring surgical revision or failure after implantation, comparing outcomes across individuals with different pre-existing health conditions and demographic traits.
descriptions.approach: A matching algorithm pairs individuals with similar background characteristics, excluding the condition being studied, to compare outcomes. Outcomes are then analyzed using standardized medical code data to assess relative risk and statistical significance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Tapping into the wealth of local banana diversity for pest and disease resistance and consumer acceptability: a catalogue of the most popular cultivars in local markets across the world

descriptions.problem: A set of local varieties is analyzed to identify which ones are most frequently chosen by consumers in markets, based on observed preferences and resilience to environmental stressors.
descriptions.approach: A mapping is constructed linking geographic regions to preferred varieties, then patterns are extracted to determine which traits correlate with high selection frequency and survival under variable conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the diversity of local fruit varieties in different markets around the world, predicts which ones are most popular and preferred by consumers, and compares their characteristics to identify the most resistant and desirable ones.
descriptions.approach: It follows a procedure where data is collected from local markets, and a model is used to categorise and compare the characteristics of the fruit varieties, identifying the most popular and preferred ones.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Use of paclobutrazol and ethylene in the potted production of ornamental pineapple

descriptions.problem: This work aims to understand how to make certain plants grow smaller and produce flowers faster, by testing different amounts of a plant growth regulator and a gas that helps plants produce flowers.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a special way of arranging the plants to test the effects of the plant growth regulator and the gas on the plants' growth and flower production. They tested different amounts of the gas at different times to see how it affects the plants' growth and flower production.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system determines how specific chemical treatments and timing of stimuli affect plant size, shape, and the timing of a reproductive transition, based on measurements of growth dimensions and structural form over time.
descriptions.approach: A structured experiment applies two treatment levels—presence or absence of a growth-modulating agent—and tests five distinct application times of a signaling compound. Outcomes are evaluated by comparing plant dimensions and structural ratios across treatment combinations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: CREATION OF ECOLOGISTIC ENTERPRISES OF THE FOOD AND PROCESSING INDUSTRY IN WESTERN UKRAINE

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to evaluate the economic and environmental viability of integrating sustainable practices into industrial operations, assessing how such integration benefits local communities and improves resource efficiency over time.
descriptions.approach: A phased implementation model is applied, starting with infrastructure for renewable energy generation, followed by waste-to-energy conversion, structured collection systems, and continuous monitoring of compliance with environmental standards.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate the effectiveness of introducing environmental practices in a specific region, comparing the benefits of these practices to the costs and identifying the necessary steps for implementation. It also aims to explain the importance of legislative support for environmental strategies.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves analyzing the stages of environmental practice introduction, proposing key steps for implementation, and highlighting the need for legislative support. This is done through a step-by-step analysis of the region's environmental conditions and the potential benefits of introducing environmental practices.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Efficacy of the Hongjing I granule herbal formulation in treating mild to moderate erectile dysfunction: A multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial protocol

descriptions.problem: This study aims to estimate the effectiveness of a traditional Chinese medicine approach in treating a common condition in men, where a significant percentage of patients do not experience improvement after taking a standard treatment. The study aims to compare the effectiveness of this approach with a standard treatment.
descriptions.approach: The study will use a simple procedure: patients will be randomly assigned to receive either the traditional Chinese medicine approach or a standard treatment, and their progress will be evaluated over 8 weeks of treatment and 16 weeks of follow-up.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A quantitative assessment is made of a patient's response to a natural remedy versus no active treatment, measuring changes in functional outcomes and subjective well-being over time.
descriptions.approach: Patients are randomly assigned to receive either the remedy or a neutral intervention. Outcomes are tracked across a set period with periodic evaluations to determine if the remedy leads to statistically significant improvements in reported health and performance metrics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Study effect of crude alcoholic extract of Hawthorn (Crataegus Oxyacantha) and crude polyphenolic compounds from blackolive (Olea Europae) fruits on some physiological parameters of kidney of male rats treated with hydrogen peroxide

descriptions.problem: A quantitative assessment of how two natural compounds influence key metabolic indicators in a biological system exposed to oxidative stress is performed, comparing outcomes across control and intervention groups.
descriptions.approach: A structured experimental design administers a stress-inducing agent over time, then measures changes in metabolic markers and tissue structure, using a defined dosing regimen and repeated sampling to evaluate protective effects.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This study investigates the protective effect of a certain plant extract and polyphenolic compounds on the kidneys of male rats that have been exposed to a toxic substance. The researchers estimate the impact of these substances on the rats' kidneys and compare the results to a control group.
descriptions.approach: The researchers divided the rats into four groups and applied different substances to them over a period of 30 days. They then measured various physiological parameters, such as the concentration of certain substances in the blood, and compared the results to the control group.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: An area-based description of closed books in general practices in Aotearoa New Zealand

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the likelihood of a general practice closing its doors based on certain characteristics, predicts which areas will be most affected, and compares the impact of different factors on the number of closed practices. It also explains why some practices may close their doors.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used maps to visualize the distribution of closed practices and statistical models to analyze the association between certain characteristics and the likelihood of closed practices. They applied linear and logistic regression to identify the most influential factors.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A spatial pattern of healthcare providers ceasing new patient intake is identified and analyzed to determine which regions and provider traits are linked to this decline.
descriptions.approach: Geographic maps are used to visualize the spread of inactive providers. Statistical models assess relationships between provider attributes and regional factors, identifying which combinations are most predictive of cessation of new patient intake.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Session Assessment of Seaplane Operations: The Case of Marine Tourism Development on Gili Iyang Island, Indonesia

descriptions.problem: Estimate the optimal conditions for reaching a small island with limited land area surrounded by water, and determine the number of effective days for a specific mode of transportation.
descriptions.approach: Use data from water conditions such as current speed, wind speed, waves height, and environmental factors to compare and optimise the performance of a specific mode of transportation.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is estimated to operate efficiently under specific environmental conditions, determining the number of days per year it can function without degradation in performance or safety.
descriptions.approach: Environmental variables such as water flow, wind, wave motion, and periodic shifts are monitored over time. A model compares operational feasibility across different environmental regimes to identify the longest continuous period of safe and effective operation.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Real-Time Estimation of Passenger Traffic Flow in Urban Railway Systems

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the future demand of a complex system, using historical data to predict its performance. It aims to provide reliable predictions to inform planning and decision-making.
descriptions.approach: The approach combines two types of neural networks: one that learns patterns in time series data, and another that analyzes relationships between different components of the system. The combined model is trained on historical data to make accurate predictions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates future usage patterns across interconnected nodes in a network based on historical observations and current conditions, aiming to predict how activity will evolve over time with high accuracy and low error.
descriptions.approach: It combines a memory-based model that captures temporal dependencies with a spatial model that processes relationships between nodes, using a unified framework to update predictions continuously as new data arrives.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: #3447 ENVIRONMENTAL MELAMINE EXPOSURE AND ADVERSE KIDNEY OUTCOMES IN PATIENTS WITH TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the relationship between exposure to a certain substance and the progression of a specific organ in patients with a particular disease. It compares the effects of this substance on the disease's progression and predicts the likelihood of adverse outcomes.
descriptions.approach: The researchers followed a large group of patients over several years, measuring the level of this substance in their bodies and tracking the progression of the disease. They used statistical methods to identify patterns and correlations between the substance's exposure and the disease's progression.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A longitudinal analysis estimates the risk of declining organ function over time in individuals with a chronic metabolic condition, based on repeated measurements of exposure to a specific environmental compound and clinical markers of organ health.
descriptions.approach: The model tracks how exposure levels correlate with worsening health outcomes over time, adjusting for patient characteristics and using statistical comparison across exposure groups to identify patterns of increased risk.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Hierarchical Automatic Multilayer Power Plane Generation With Genetic Optimization and Multilayer Perceptron

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the best way to design a complex network of interconnected components, such as those found in electronic devices, by comparing many possible solutions and choosing the best one. It aims to optimize the layout of these components to minimize errors and improve performance.
descriptions.approach: The method uses a combination of a search algorithm and a mathematical model to find the best solution. It starts by generating many possible solutions, then uses a mathematical model to evaluate and compare them, and finally chooses the best one.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates optimal layouts for complex electrical networks by predicting how current distributes across interconnected regions under varying load and topology conditions.
descriptions.approach: It uses iterative refinement guided by evolutionary rules and a predictive model that evaluates structural similarity and performance metrics to generate efficient, low-resistance configurations through successive optimization and clustering.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Introduction

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate the effectiveness of a new teaching method in higher education, comparing it to traditional methods. It predicts how students will perform and learn with this new approach.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use data from past teaching experiences and experiments to develop a model that predicts student outcomes. They then test this model with new data to see how well it works.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A method is developed to predict how students engage with learning tasks based on their initial interest levels and the structure of classroom activities.
descriptions.approach: Students are observed during sessions, and their participation patterns are analyzed. A model adjusts teaching strategies in real time based on observed engagement levels and past performance trends.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Accentuating the positive and eliminating the negative: Efficacy of TiO2 as digestibility index marker for poultry nutrition studies

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of adding a specific substance to a mixture of substances on the presence of another substance in the mixture. It predicts whether the presence of the substance affects the recovery of a specific substance from the mixture.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves adding the substance to the mixture and then analyzing the mixture to see if the specific substance is present. The analysis is done in a controlled environment with different levels of the substance and different levels of the specific substance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The effect of a dietary additive on the breakdown and recovery of a specific nutrient complex is assessed across different treatment levels and biological compartments.
descriptions.approach: A chemical agent is introduced into a sample environment under controlled conditions to bind and concentrate a target compound. The resulting concentration in different sample locations is measured and compared across treatment groups to evaluate interference with the natural processing pathway.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A potential cost of evolving epibatidine resistance in poison frogs

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of a specific amino acid substitution on the sensitivity of a certain type of biological molecule to a particular substance, and compares it to the sensitivity of the same molecule to another substance. It also predicts the potential cost of this substitution.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves introducing the substitution into a model of the molecule, then testing its effect on the molecule's sensitivity to the substance and another substance. The approach also involves comparing the results to those of non-related biological molecules.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A change in a specific amino acid is assessed for its effect on a biological system's response to a key signaling molecule, comparing outcomes across different species and evaluating whether the change alters the system's overall sensitivity or output.
descriptions.approach: A modified version of a protein complex is introduced into different biological systems. The resulting response is measured under controlled conditions, and the total activity is quantified to determine if changes in output stem from altered protein assembly or surface expression.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Analysis of the behavior of the floating systems used for boundary of river-sea recreational activities area

descriptions.problem: Estimate the performance of a system that marks boundaries of safe areas for people to enter water, taking into account various environmental conditions and potential hazards. The system must be able to withstand damage and maintain its shape over time.
descriptions.approach: Use computer simulations to predict the behavior of the system under different conditions, and then test the system in real-world settings to validate the predictions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to maintain a stable and visible boundary in dynamic aquatic environments exposed to wave action, temperature shifts, and weather extremes. The performance of the structure is evaluated under real-time environmental conditions over time.
descriptions.approach: A cylindrical-shaped structure is modeled using finite element methods to predict its response to environmental forces. Physical testing under variable weather conditions confirms its structural integrity and consistent shape retention over extended exposure.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Toward a Theoretical and Analytical Framework for the Study of Sexual Humour in Chaucerian Fabliaux

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the medieval views on laughter and its role in bringing pleasure to readers, comparing them to modern understandings. It predicts how these views influenced the representation of certain subjects in comic plots.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a combination of historical research and close reading of literary works to tease out the underlying social and cultural context. It follows a procedure of exploring medieval attitudes, analyzing specific plots, and comparing these to modern interpretations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of audience engagement is inferred from narrative sequences involving deception, bodily exposure, and surprise revelations, using historical sources that describe bodily functions and social norms to interpret how such events provoke response.
descriptions.approach: A model maps narrative events to known societal beliefs about bodily behavior and social taboos, then evaluates how specific plot structures trigger emotional or cognitive reactions in a presumed audience.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: THE MAIN WAYS OF LEAKING COMMERCIAL SECRETS AND MEASURES TO PROTECT THEM

descriptions.problem: A system is identified that maps how sensitive knowledge escapes from institutions through interactions with external parties, and how institutions respond with structured safeguards to limit exposure.
descriptions.approach: A framework compares policies across regions, categorizes exposure pathways, and evaluates protective strategies—such as access controls, technological barriers, and procedural updates—based on real-world reports from institutional stakeholders.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This study aims to compare and analyze how different countries protect valuable information from being shared with others. It estimates the effectiveness of various methods used to safeguard this information.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of methods to gather data, including expert surveys and visual presentations. They then categorized and compared the results to identify the most effective measures for protecting valuable information.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Efficacy of an oral combination of moxidectin, afoxolaner, and pyrantel pamoate for the prevention of heartworm disease in dogs

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the effectiveness of a treatment in preventing a serious disease caused by a parasite that is spread by mosquitoes. It compares the results of laboratory and field studies to determine if the treatment is effective in real-world conditions.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of three active ingredients to create a treatment, and tested it in two laboratory studies and one field study. They gave the treatment to groups of animals and tested them for the presence of the parasite over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The effectiveness of a preventive treatment is estimated by comparing infection rates in a group receiving the treatment to a group receiving no treatment, using biological and laboratory evidence over time.
descriptions.approach: A treatment is administered at regular intervals to a group of animals, and infection status is monitored through repeated testing. The absence of infection in treated animals compared to infected controls confirms the treatment's preventive capability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Decarbonization of the Russia mining industry

descriptions.problem: Estimate the impact of increasing global temperatures on the number of floods and hurricanes, and the melting of permafrost, and identify the potential losses. The goal is to find ways to reduce the negative effects of industrial development on the environment.
descriptions.approach: Analyze data on the current state of industrial development, its environmental impact, and the potential consequences of increasing global temperatures. Identify the most effective methods to reduce negative effects and mitigate losses.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is evaluated to reduce greenhouse gas output during resource extraction and processing, based on operational data and material flow patterns.
descriptions.approach: A set of strategies is applied, including on-site power generation, transport efficiency improvements, process optimization, and capturing and storing emissions, all implemented in combination to achieve overall emission reduction.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Sooty Tern Optimization Technique based 2DOFPID Controller for Stability of Multisource Power System with Plug-in Electric Vehicles Integration

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the stability of a complex system with multiple sources of power, and predicts how it will behave under different conditions. It compares the performance of different regulators to find the best one.
descriptions.approach: The system is simulated with a specific type of regulator that can adjust two variables to optimize the system's performance. The regulator is optimized using a new algorithm to find the best settings.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system's response to sudden load changes is evaluated under real-time communication lags and variable input sources, including distributed energy units with dynamic behavior.
descriptions.approach: A feedback mechanism adjusts control parameters in real time based on system response, using an adaptive search algorithm to refine gains and maintain stability under varying conditions and delays.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: IMPACT OF BUOYANCY ON AXISYMMETRIC POWELL-EYRING FLUID WITH JOULE HEATING IN PRESENCE OF CHEMICAL REACTION

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the effect of a certain force on the flow of a fluid with heat and chemical reactions. It compares the results to earlier findings and optimizes the understanding of how the fluid behaves under these conditions.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of mathematical equations and numerical methods to analyze the flow. They transformed the equations into a system of ordinary differential equations and solved them using a specific numerical technique.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The system estimates how changes in material resistance, thermal effects, and chemical interaction influence flow speed, temperature, and concentration distributions near a stretching surface.
descriptions.approach: A simplified set of equations is derived using similarity transformations. These are solved numerically with a robust iterative method. Results are visualized and compared to prior studies to validate trends in response to varying physical conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Toward urban traffic scenarios and more: a spatio-temporal analysis empowered low-rank tensor completion method for data imputation

descriptions.problem: A system estimates missing values in a dynamic, multi-dimensional dataset where observations are irregularly recorded across space and time, relying on inherent patterns and relationships to infer what is absent.
descriptions.approach: The method models the data as a structured, low-dimensional representation where nearby points in space and time are assumed to be similar. It uses known relationships between locations and time points to reconstruct missing entries by preserving both global consistency and local dependencies.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate or predict the state of a complex system with many interconnected parts, where some data is missing. It also compares the performance of different methods to fill in the missing data and optimise the system's state.
descriptions.approach: The method uses a special kind of mathematical model that embeds the system's structure into the data, and then solves a complex mathematical problem to fill in the missing data. It uses a combination of local and global information to make the best predictions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: The Different Experiences of X-Culture: Which is Yours?

descriptions.problem: Estimate and compare the effectiveness of X-Culture's coaching program and its impact on students' learning outcomes, based on data collected from participants.
descriptions.approach: Use a combination of quantitative and qualitative data to model the relationships between X-Culture's coaching program, student learning outcomes, and participant experiences, and to identify areas for improvement.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of shared engagement is observed across diverse groups, and the nature of individual involvement within that pattern is assessed using self-reported and observational records.
descriptions.approach: Participants report their level of immersion, interaction frequency, and emotional response over time, then cluster similar responses to identify distinct engagement profiles and their underlying dynamics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Sum of Exponential Model for Fitting Data

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the sum of a set of values that are assumed to be related to a underlying pattern, using a mathematical model that fits a specific number of patterns to the data. The goal is to find the best fit for the data.
descriptions.approach: The model uses a combination of patterns to fit the data, with a specific number of patterns used to estimate the underlying values. The process involves calculating the best fit for the data using a straightforward algorithm.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of observations is analyzed to determine a pattern of change over time, where the change is composed of multiple distinct components that evolve at different rates.
descriptions.approach: The data is modeled as a combination of base functions that grow or decay at fixed rates. Parameters for each function are adjusted so that the sum of these components best matches the observed values across time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Smoothing of numerical series by the triangle method on the example of hungarian gdp data 1992-2022 based on approximation by series of exponents

descriptions.problem: This work estimates a functional relationship between a set of values and a desired description, taking into account errors in the observed values. It aims to find a simpler, more accurate way to describe the relationship.
descriptions.approach: The approach uses a specific method to average the data and increase the accuracy of the description, allowing for the estimation of intermediate values not listed in the original data.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A sequence of measured values over time is analyzed to infer underlying trends by identifying a pattern that fits the data better than simple interpolation.
descriptions.approach: A weighted average is computed by combining adjacent data points in a symmetric pattern, where each point's influence decreases as distance from the center increases, resulting in a refined estimate of the underlying trend.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Nonlinear transient voltage and frequency-coordinated control strategy for the renewable energy sending system

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the impact of a sudden change in the system's power supply on its stability, and predicts how the system's frequency and stability will change over time. It compares the system's performance under different scenarios to determine the most effective control strategy.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves analyzing the system's behavior using a simplified model, and then using this analysis to develop a control strategy that can adapt to changing conditions. The strategy is tested using a computer model to see how well it works in practice.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A method is developed to maintain stability in a power network when sudden changes in supply occur, coordinating responses to keep both frequency and voltage within safe operational limits.
descriptions.approach: A dynamic model captures how system states evolve under sudden load or generation shifts. It uses real-time feedback to adjust responses from energy storage, balancing rapid adjustments with long-term stability to restore equilibrium quickly.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: IMPACTS OF EGREGIA MENZIESII, A FOUNDATIONAL ALGA, ON INTERTIDAL COMMUNITIES IN SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA AND NORTHERN WASHINGTON
