descriptions.problem: This study estimates the impact of a foundational species on community structure in two regions, comparing it to a control group and a manipulated group. It also predicts the effects of the species on community diversity and composition.
descriptions.approach: The researcher surveyed community structure at regular intervals, analyzed metrics of community composition and diversity, and tested the ability of a replica to mimic the effects of the species in the field.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of biological community composition is assessed across different environmental conditions and over time to determine how a dominant plant-like organism influences species diversity and distribution.
descriptions.approach: Plots are exposed to three conditions: natural presence, removal, and absence of the organism. Community metrics are measured periodically, and differences are evaluated using statistical comparisons across time and treatment groups.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Recurrent ventricular arrhythmia due to aconite intoxication successfully treated with landiolol: A case report

descriptions.problem: A system exhibits uncontrolled, rapidly recurring electrical disturbances that disrupt normal function and persist despite initial interventions. The goal is to identify a treatment that stabilizes the system and restores normal rhythmic activity.
descriptions.approach: A continuous infusion of a substance that dampens sympathetic overactivity is applied. The response is monitored over time to determine when the system returns to a stable, regular pattern of activity.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of a treatment for a potentially life-threatening condition caused by ingesting a poisonous plant, and compares it to a standard treatment. It predicts the outcome of the treatment and explains why it was successful.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from a patient's medical history and test results to determine the best course of treatment. They applied a specific medication to suppress a potentially deadly heart rhythm, and monitored the patient's response to the treatment.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Formation and 3D Stacking Process of CMOS Chips with Backside Buried Metal Power Distribution Networks

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the formation and 3D arrangement of thin, flexible electronic components with a hidden power distribution system. It predicts the optimal structure and procedure for these components, comparing different methods and materials.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves simultaneously forming a hidden power distribution system and the electronic components' structure, using a series of thinning, etching, and filling steps. The components are then bonded together using a special adhesive, allowing for multiple layers to be stacked on top of each other.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A thin semiconductor device is enhanced with a conductive network embedded in its base side, and multiple such devices are joined together in three dimensions using a bonding technique that relies on material diffusion between solid and liquid phases.
descriptions.approach: A wafer is thinned and patterned to form holes and channels; a dielectric film is deposited and cured at low temperature, followed by metal filling and polishing. Devices are then bonded together through a diffusion-based interface that fuses the surfaces of adjacent units.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Should Secondary Cytoreductive Surgery be Offered to all Patients that are Surgical Candidates with Optimally Resectable Recurrent Uterine Leiomyosarcoma?

descriptions.problem: A model estimates the likelihood that a treatment intervention will improve outcomes in individuals with advanced, localized spread of a malignancy, based on the volume and timing of spread, and the biological behavior of the tumor.
descriptions.approach: The model evaluates tumor characteristics and disease progression patterns to assign a risk score, then applies a decision rule that favors intervention only when the spread is limited and the disease course is slow and controllable.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: Estimate the likelihood of success for a treatment option based on the characteristics of the underlying condition, and compare it to a standard approach. The goal is to determine whether the alternative treatment is likely to be more effective for a specific subset of individuals.
descriptions.approach: Use a combination of data analysis and expert judgment to evaluate the potential benefits and risks of the alternative treatment. The approach involves identifying key factors that influence treatment success, such as the volume and location of the underlying condition, and the patient's overall health status.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Learning-Based Ad Auction Design with Externalities: The Framework and A Matching-Based Approach

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the optimal way to design a system that rewards users for interacting with ads, while also considering how ads affect other items on the platform. It predicts the best outcome by comparing different design options.
descriptions.approach: The system uses a combination of data and mathematical rules to design the system. It follows a procedure that involves creating a scoring system and an algorithm to allocate rewards to users.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates how the presence of one promoted item affects the performance of others, and predicts the best way to assign promotions to users based on observed interactions and preferences.
descriptions.approach: It assigns scores to items based on user behavior patterns and uses a pairing rule to match promotions to users, ensuring that the overall outcome is fair and maximizes user engagement while maintaining consistency in decision-making.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Approach to Geriatric Anemia

descriptions.problem: This research aims to evaluate and diagnose a 70-year-old woman's symptoms of shortness of breath, palpitations, and weakness, and to identify the underlying cause of her condition. The goal is to determine the type of condition she has and to develop a treatment plan.
descriptions.approach: The researcher uses a combination of physical examination, laboratory tests, and medical history to diagnose the condition. The approach involves testing for various conditions, such as gastrointestinal bleeding, cardiac problems, and nutritional deficiencies, and using laboratory results to differentiate between possible causes.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the likely cause of a persistent low energy state in an older individual, predicting whether it stems from a loss of cellular components, a reduced ability to utilize stored resources, or an underlying condition suppressing production.
descriptions.approach: The system analyzes laboratory indicators including cell size, stored material levels, and production efficiency. It compares these to known patterns to assign a most probable origin, then recommends interventions based on the nature and severity of the underlying deficit.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Reading styles modulate perceptual roles of the hands in bimanual braille reading

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the optimal hand movement patterns for individuals to read text efficiently, comparing the performance of different hand movement patterns. It also explains how the way people move their hands affects their ability to read text quickly and accurately.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves analyzing the movement patterns of individuals as they read text aloud, using specialized tracking systems to record their hand movements. The results are then compared to identify the most efficient hand movement patterns.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The relative contribution of each limb during tactile text acquisition is estimated from movement patterns and performance metrics across different behavioral strategies.
descriptions.approach: Movement data are analyzed to detect patterns of independent versus coordinated limb actions, and performance is correlated with the degree of temporal and spatial separation between limb inputs.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: LIPID PEROXIDATION AND ANTIOXIDANT PROTECTION SYSTEM IN RATS UNDER CONDITIONS OF ISCHEMIC STROKE ON THE BACKGROUND OF ANXIETY-DEPRESSIVE DISORDERS

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the impact of a severe condition on the body's ability to protect itself from damage, and compares the effects of this condition with a related condition that is also severe. It predicts the outcome of a combination of these two conditions.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a model to simulate the severe condition, and then studied the effects of this condition and the related condition on the body's protective mechanisms. They measured the levels of certain chemicals in the body to understand the impact of these conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system's resilience under stress is evaluated by measuring the levels of oxidative damage and protective mechanisms in biological tissue, using markers of molecular degradation and enzyme activity in both tissue and blood samples.
descriptions.approach: A controlled experiment applies a simulated disruption to a biological system and monitors changes in molecular stability and enzymatic activity over time, comparing outcomes across different stress conditions and baseline states.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Pemberian Madu Murni Dalam Menurunkan Tekanan Darah Pada Lansia Hipertensi

descriptions.problem: This research aims to investigate the effect of a specific substance on a common health issue in older adults, specifically those with high pressure in their arteries. It estimates the change in pressure levels in these individuals after consuming the substance.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a case study method, collecting data through interviews and observations. It follows a simple procedure: administering the substance to participants and measuring their pressure levels before and after a set period.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A change in a physiological metric is measured over time in individuals with a chronic condition, comparing pre- and post-intervention values to determine if a specific substance influences the outcome.
descriptions.approach: A structured observation and reporting protocol is applied over a fixed period. The intervention involves daily administration of a specific substance, and the resulting change in the metric is recorded and analyzed for statistical significance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: UNILATERAL RHINITIS AND HEMOBARTONELLA FELIS INFECTION IN DOMESTIC CATS WITH A HISTORY OF CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the presence of a specific type of infection in a subject with a history of a chronic disease, and compares the results to a set of diagnostic criteria. It also predicts the likely cause of a set of symptoms and provides a treatment plan.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves collecting data on the subject's symptoms and test results, and then using a combination of diagnostic techniques to identify the presence of the infection. The treatment plan is based on a set of established protocols and is tailored to the subject's specific needs.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of persistent mucosal discharge and systemic weakness is observed in an individual with chronic organ dysfunction. The presence of intracellular pathogens is assessed through microscopic detection of abnormal cellular inclusions, and the overall health trajectory is evaluated against baseline physiological indicators.
descriptions.approach: A treatment regimen is applied involving long-term antimicrobial therapy, short-term anti-inflammatory intervention, and supportive nutritional measures. Response is monitored through repeated checks of cellular morphology and overall vitality over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Accuracy, Hemorrhagic Complications and CT Radiation Dose of Emergency External Ventricular Drain (EVD) Placement in Pediatric Patients: A 15-Year Retrospective Analysis

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the accuracy of a medical procedure, compares the frequency of certain complications, and optimizes the use of medical imaging technology. It also explains the results of a 15-year retrospective analysis of a specific medical intervention.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of medical records and imaging data to assess the procedure's accuracy and complications. They compared their results to established standards and guidelines to optimize the procedure's effectiveness and minimize unnecessary exposure to medical imaging technology.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system evaluates the success of a medical procedure by measuring how well a device is positioned, how often unintended bleeding occurs, and the amount of imaging energy used during follow-up checks.
descriptions.approach: It analyzes historical records of patient outcomes and imaging data, classifies positioning and bleeding into predefined levels, and compares imaging energy metrics to established benchmarks to determine performance and safety.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Manufacture of Polymer Concrete Based on Snake-Fruit Seeds (Salacca zalacca) and Sawdust with Polyester Resin as an Adhesive

descriptions.problem: This study aims to determine the effect of adding a certain material and a byproduct of wood processing on the physical and mechanical properties of a composite material. The goal is to estimate the impact of these additives on the material's density, porosity, and water absorption, as well as its resistance to compression, tension, and bending.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of measurements and visual inspections to compare the properties of two different composite materials. They analyzed the microstructure of the materials using a scanning electron microscope to identify any differences in the material's appearance and composition.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The task is to evaluate how varying the proportions of two natural materials and a binding agent influence the resulting material's density, porosity, water uptake, and resistance to deformation under load.
descriptions.approach: A set of mixtures is prepared with different ratios of components. Each mixture is subjected to physical and mechanical testing. Results are analyzed to determine how ingredient distribution affects internal structure and performance under stress.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Survey on Data Ingestion for AutoML (S)

descriptions.problem: This work aims to identify how data is prepared for use in models that help computers make decisions without human help. It estimates what features are important for making this process easier and more efficient.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a systematic review of existing studies to identify the key features of this process. They looked at 6 studies that described how to make this process easier and more efficient.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates how effectively raw observations are transformed into usable forms for training models, by evaluating how well data is structured, validated, and made consistent across different sources and formats.
descriptions.approach: It evaluates patterns in data flow and user feedback to determine which methods best detect inconsistencies, guide decisions on data structure, and ensure reliability through visual inspection and consistency checks.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Awareness regarding knowledge associated with polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) among women in Wardha district- A cross-sectional study.

descriptions.problem: This study aims to estimate the level of knowledge and awareness about a common hormonal disorder that affects women's reproductive health, particularly in a specific region of India. It seeks to compare the prevalence of this disorder and its associated symptoms across different populations.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a standardized questionnaire to collect data from a large sample size, aiming to minimize bias and increase accuracy. The approach involves analyzing the data to identify patterns and trends in knowledge and awareness of the disorder.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A measure of understanding about a common endocrine condition is estimated from self-reported information collected across a defined geographic region.
descriptions.approach: A standardized set of questions is used to gather responses from individuals, and the consistency and patterns in their answers are analyzed to assess the level of public knowledge about the condition's signs and implications.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Women Representation in the Military: The Case of the South African National Defence Force, Limpopo Province

descriptions.problem: This research aims to understand the representation of a specific group in a particular institution, and whether the institution's policies and practices are adequate to promote equal representation. It estimates the current level of representation, predicts future trends, and compares the institution's policies to the group's needs.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a qualitative research methodology to collect data through in-depth interviews, and then analyzed the data using a thematic analysis technique to identify patterns and themes in the participants' responses.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of underrepresentation is assessed across military ranks, comparing observed participation levels to institutional policies and societal perceptions of inclusion in combat and leadership roles.
descriptions.approach: In-depth interviews are conducted with participants from a specific unit until key themes saturate; responses are coded thematically and analyzed to identify systemic barriers and perceived shifts in inclusion over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Development and delivery of a higher diploma in emergency medicine and critical care for clinical officers in Kenya

descriptions.problem: Estimate the effectiveness of a training program in a cost-efficient manner to address preventable deaths in low- and middle-income countries.
descriptions.approach: Use a framework to develop and deliver a training program for individuals working in emergency situations, with the goal of improving their skills and knowledge in a specific area.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A structured training pathway is designed to equip personnel with advanced skills for managing acute and life-threatening conditions in resource-constrained environments.
descriptions.approach: A curriculum is developed using a proven framework, then implemented across diverse geographic and operational settings to evaluate its effectiveness and scalability in improving outcomes for high-risk patient scenarios.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Truck speed prediction with a simple two-stage neural network using GPS data and Monte Carlo (MC) dropout

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the travel speed of a vehicle based on its location and past movements, aiming to provide early alerts for drivers and management teams to prevent accidents. It predicts the speed of a vehicle from its GPS data.
descriptions.approach: The approach uses a combination of two neural networks: one that learns patterns in the data and another that makes predictions based on those patterns. The model follows a procedure where it trains the networks on historical data and then tests their accuracy on real-world data.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the velocity of a moving vehicle based on its historical position over time, using real-time location records to infer future motion patterns.
descriptions.approach: First, a sequence model analyzes past position changes to capture temporal dynamics. Then, a final layer refines the velocity estimate using multiple independent predictions, averaging them to improve confidence and stability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Modern approaches to the correction of age-related skin changes in women

descriptions.problem: A model estimates the rate of decline in structural integrity of biological tissues over time, influenced by both internal biological shifts and repeated environmental exposures, and predicts how interventions can stabilize or reverse these changes.
descriptions.approach: The model integrates longitudinal data on tissue degradation and exposure history, applying a dynamic rule that adjusts outcomes based on lifestyle modifications and targeted interventions to maintain tissue resilience over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the impact of various factors on the aging process of a specific type of tissue, and compares the effects of different interventions to improve its appearance. It aims to explain the underlying causes of age-related changes and optimize treatment options.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a literature review to analyze the effects of external and internal factors on the aging process. It examines various methods of aesthetic correction and evaluates their advantages and disadvantages.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: KLF5 Promotes Tumor Progression and Parp Inhibitor Resistance in Ovarian Cancer

descriptions.problem: This work identifies a key factor that influences the growth and spread of abnormal cells, and how it affects the effectiveness of a specific treatment. It also explores how this factor contributes to the development of resistance to that treatment.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use data from patients to identify a specific pattern of gene activity that is associated with poor outcomes. They then use this information to understand how this pattern affects the growth and spread of abnormal cells, and how it impacts the effectiveness of a specific treatment.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system-wide regulatory factor is identified that enhances the expression of a key DNA repair gene, leading to increased cellular resilience against targeted therapies in disease states with compromised treatment response.
descriptions.approach: A transcriptional complex is formed and targeted to a specific gene promoter, where it amplifies expression of a DNA repair enzyme. This activity is suppressed by a small-molecule inhibitor combined with a targeted agent, resulting in reduced survival of resistant disease cells.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

topic_name: Genetic and Clinical Aspects of Sex Determination and Chromosomal Abnormalities
title: Anti‐Mullerian hormone and spontaneous puberty in a diverse US Turner syndrome clinic cohort: A cross‐sectional study

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the distribution of a hormone in a group of patients with a specific genetic condition, and compares it to the presence of certain physical characteristics and the development of reproductive features. It also examines the hormone's relationship to the patients' age and reproductive status.
descriptions.approach: The researchers looked at data from patients' charts to determine the hormone's levels and how they relate to the patients' genetic makeup and reproductive development. They used statistical methods to identify patterns and correlations in the data.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A biological marker is measured across individuals to assess its relationship with genetic variation and the timing of a developmental event, and to evaluate its connection with early hormonal signals in infancy.
descriptions.approach: A retrospective analysis of stored measurements is conducted, grouping individuals by genetic makeup and developmental milestones, then comparing marker levels across groups and linking them to early hormonal activity in early life.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Foundations of Social Institutions and the Place of LGBTQ in the Contemporary Society

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the acceptance of certain activities in different foundations of society, such as family, education, religion, health, and economy. It compares the level of acceptance across these foundations and explains why the acceptance is low.
descriptions.approach: The study follows a procedure where it examines the relationships between the foundations and the activities in question, using data from a global survey conducted in 2021.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The degree to which certain groups are permitted to participate in core societal structures is assessed across diverse cultural and political environments.
descriptions.approach: A structured framework evaluates how different societal systems—such as family, schooling, spiritual guidance, medical care, and economic systems—acknowledge or restrict the presence and activities of individuals who identify outside traditional norms.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Lightning Talk 21: EDA with ML, Rule-Based, or Both?

descriptions.problem: This work aims to compare the efficiency of two methods when working with a large amount of data: a complex model with many parameters, and a rule-based system. The goal is to determine which method is better suited for high and low data volumes.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using a complex model to estimate the performance of the rule-based system, and then comparing the two methods. The rule-based system is also investigated in combination with the complex model, where the rules are revised based on the model's guidance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates how well a design performs under specific constraints, predicting outcomes based on layout patterns and known performance metrics, using either large datasets or limited observations.
descriptions.approach: A model analyzes patterns in spatial data using statistical rules when data is scarce, and adapts those rules using learned patterns from data-rich environments to improve accuracy and consistency.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Thrombotic microangiopathies after kidney transplantation in modern era: nosology based on chronology

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the incidence of a rare but severe condition in patients who have received a transplant, and compares the causes and prognosis of different types of this condition. It also explains the management of this condition in various situations.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from consecutive patients who received a transplant over a period of 12 years, and analyzed the timing of the condition to identify patterns and correlations.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of adverse events is identified and categorized by when they occur after transplantation, with distinct rates, underlying causes, and outcomes for each timing group.
descriptions.approach: Events are observed over time and grouped into early, unexpected, and late phases. For each phase, the frequency, triggers, and long-term consequences are analyzed and compared across groups.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Parental sex-preferences in South Africa: culture and family composition

descriptions.problem: A pattern of preference is estimated for the number of offspring of a given sex in a household, based on self-reported ideals from individuals across different social and demographic groups.
descriptions.approach: The pattern is modeled by comparing responses across groups defined by residence, education, economic status, marital structure, and household size, then adjusting for observed household characteristics and social context.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the ideal number of children for families in South Africa, comparing the preferences of two groups and examining the impact of various factors on these preferences. It also explains how these preferences change based on the current family situation.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from a survey to compare the ideal family sizes of two groups, and then analyzed the impact of different factors on these preferences. They found that cultural and social factors had a significant impact on these preferences.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Spatiotemporal miRNA and transcriptomic network dynamically regulate the developmental and senescence processes of poplar leaves

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the developmental stages of a certain type of plant growth, from young to mature and then to decline, based on changes in its physiological and physical characteristics. It also compares these stages to identify the underlying genetic mechanisms.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of data analysis techniques, including classification and clustering, to identify patterns in the plant's genetic data. They then constructed a network of genes that work together to regulate the plant's growth and development.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A dynamic regulatory pattern across time and space is inferred from gene and small RNA expression levels across distinct developmental phases, to identify key control nodes that influence growth and decline trajectories.
descriptions.approach: Expression data is clustered into temporal segments, then mapped to co-occurring gene and regulatory element patterns to build a network where nodes represent active regulatory units and edges represent strength of interaction across phases.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Treatment options for necrobiosis lipoidica: a systematic review

descriptions.problem: This work aims to collect and compare information on various methods used to help a rare, skin condition that causes collagen degeneration. It estimates the effectiveness of different methods and identifies the most promising ones.
descriptions.approach: The researchers searched for studies on various methods used to help this condition, and then analyzed the results to identify the most effective methods. They looked at case reports and series, but wanted more randomized controlled trials to compare the effectiveness of different methods.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A set of interventions is evaluated based on their outcomes in individual or group cases, with emphasis on effectiveness and reported results across diverse patient experiences.
descriptions.approach: A structured search of published accounts is conducted, filtering only those that describe both an intervention and a follow-up outcome. Evidence is compiled and summarized by type of intervention and patient response rate.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Palatability of Norway spruce needles infected with Lophodermium piceae to larvae of two sawfly species

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of a certain type of fungus on the growth of a specific type of plant, and compares it to the growth of the same plant without the fungus. It also predicts how a certain type of insect will react to the fungus-infected plant.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a new method to create plants without the fungus, and then inoculated some of them with the fungus. They then transferred a certain type of insect to the plants with and without the fungus, and measured how much of the plant's growth material the insects consumed.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The extent to which insect herbivores consume plant material is measured under controlled conditions involving different plant treatments.
descriptions.approach: A set of plant specimens is exposed to insect herbivores under identical environmental conditions. Consumption is quantified and compared across treatments to determine if plant condition influences feeding behavior.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Phytochemical profiling and neuroprotective activity of Callistemon subulatus leaves against cyclophosphamide-induced chemobrain

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the composition of a plant extract and its potential benefits against a toxic substance's negative effects on cognitive function. It predicts the effectiveness of the extract in mitigating these effects and explains the underlying mechanisms.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a combination of high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and mass spectrometry (MS) to identify the extract's compounds. It then tests the extract's effects on cognitive function in rats, using behavioral tests and histological examination to evaluate the results.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A compound mixture is analyzed to identify its chemical components using separation and mass detection. Its ability to mitigate cognitive decline in an animal model is assessed through behavioral tests, tissue examination, and enzyme activity measurements.
descriptions.approach: Chemical components are separated and characterized via liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry. The mixture is administered alongside a stressor, and its effects on memory, enzyme function, and cellular redox balance are monitored over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Character Education Values in the Bugis Traditional Game of Mappasajang: An Islamic Perspective

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the presence of noble values in a traditional activity, compares them to Islamic principles, and optimizes the benefits of this activity for personal growth and social cohesion. It aims to explain how this activity can be used to develop essential life skills.
descriptions.approach: The researchers employed observation and interview to collect data, using empirical research in a specific village. They then analyzed the data to identify the benefits of this activity and its alignment with Islamic values.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is evaluated to determine how deeply interpersonal and communal skills are embedded in a structured activity involving group interaction and rule-based progression.
descriptions.approach: Observations and dialogues are conducted over time to map how participants respond to challenges, adapt under pressure, and maintain cooperative behavior, then compared against established behavioral principles for social harmony and resilience.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Artemisia santonicum L. and Artemisia lerchiana Web. Essential Oils and Exudates as Sources of Compounds with Pesticidal Action

descriptions.problem: A quantitative assessment is made of how different liquid extracts affect biological processes in plants, including seed activation and enzyme function, using measured responses across varying concentrations and conditions.
descriptions.approach: Extracts are prepared from plant parts through physical separation and chemical solvents. Their effects are tested across multiple biological endpoints using controlled exposure and response measurement to determine potency and specificity.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effectiveness of certain plant extracts as pesticides, comparing their ability to inhibit seed germination, a chemical enzyme, and the growth of certain fungi. It also compares the effectiveness of different concentrations of these extracts.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of laboratory experiments to evaluate the extracts' effectiveness. They analyzed the chemical composition of the extracts using a specific technique and then tested their effects on various biological systems.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: All Biodisintegratable Hydrogel Biohybrid Neural Interfaces with Synergistic Performances of Microelectrode Array Technologies, Tissue Scaffolding, and Cell Therapy

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the effectiveness of a new type of device that combines electrical stimulation and cell transplantation to repair damaged biological systems. It predicts how well this device will work in different situations and compares its performance to existing methods.
descriptions.approach: The device is made from a flexible, biodegradable material that can be easily integrated into the body. It uses a combination of electrical stimulation and cell transplantation to repair damaged biological systems, and is designed to be completely degraded after a certain period of time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to monitor and enhance biological signal dynamics over time, integrating electrical stimulation with living cell activity to promote functional recovery in damaged biological networks.
descriptions.approach: A self-assembling, degradable material forms a conductive and adhesive layer that interfaces with biological tissues, enabling stable signal transmission and cell interaction while gradually breaking down in response to environmental cues.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: S4045 Brunner’s Gland Cystic Lesions: An Unusual Finding on Upper Endoscopy

descriptions.problem: A pattern of mucosal abnormalities is identified in a gastrointestinal tract segment, where small, well-defined, fluid-filled structures appear and are assessed for potential malignancy.
descriptions.approach: An imaging sequence is performed to evaluate the depth and structure of the abnormalities, followed by tissue sampling and histological analysis to determine whether the structures originate from normal mucosal tissue and respond to acid suppression.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the presence of a rare, benign growth in the small intestine, which can be mistaken for a more serious condition. It compares this growth to other possible causes of a similar appearance, and optimizes treatment by controlling stomach acid.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of endoscopic examination and imaging tests to identify the growth. They then took a sample from the growth and examined it under a microscope to confirm its benign nature.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

topic_name: Genetic and Clinical Aspects of Sex Determination and Chromosomal Abnormalities
title: A polygenic explanation for Haldane’s rule in butterflies

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the impact of unbalanced genetic mixing on the fitness of female individuals with mixed sex chromosomes. It predicts that this imbalance is more pronounced in these individuals and that the proportion of mixed ancestry varies more on the sex chromosome.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use data from two closely related species to investigate the effects of unbalanced genetic mixing on fitness. They control for statistical linkage among multiple genes to determine if the observed effects are consistent with a single gene basis.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The relative fitness of offspring from mixed genetic backgrounds is estimated across different genetic combinations, and patterns of fitness decline are compared across sexes and genomic regions.
descriptions.approach: Genetic data from cross-breeding experiments are analyzed to detect regions where ancestry from one parent is unevenly distributed. Statistical models adjust for local genetic correlations to reveal true effects, distinguishing between isolated strong effects and widespread, subtle contributions from many genes.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: MODELING OF RECIPROCAL FRAMES WITH GEODESIC GRIDS DEPLOYABLE FROM FLAT TO CURVED SURFACE

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the optimal shape of a three-dimensional structure that can be built from short and small components, and compares it to real-world models. It aims to explain how to design and construct such a structure using a new method.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves creating a flexible, elastic framework that can be built from flat components. It uses numerical analysis and simulation to test the structure's behavior and optimize its design.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A method is developed to transform a planar configuration into a three-dimensional form that conforms to a specified curved shape while maintaining structural integrity and consistent joint alignment.
descriptions.approach: A computational framework deforms a rigid network of interconnected elements by adjusting their relative positions along predefined paths, simulating material behavior under stress and ensuring consistent spatial continuity across the transformation.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Harnessing green technology and innovation for inclusive and sustainable development

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the potential benefits of adopting green technologies and innovations in various sectors and countries, comparing them to current levels of development. It aims to identify the most promising opportunities for inclusive and sustainable development.
descriptions.approach: The study uses data from different industries and countries to predict the outcomes of adopting green technologies and innovations. It follows a procedure of comparing current levels of development to predicted levels, and optimising strategies for each sector and country.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: It estimates how different technological pathways in various regions can lead to improved outcomes in resource use and societal well-being, based on local conditions and available inputs.
descriptions.approach: It evaluates potential strategies by simulating how changes in technology adoption and policy responses affect environmental impact and development outcomes across diverse settings.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: The Impact of Carvedilol on Organ Index, Inflammatory Mediators, Oxidative Stress Parameters and Skin Markers in D-Galactose-Induced Aging Mice

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of a certain substance on various biological markers in mice that have been induced to age prematurely. It aims to compare the impact of this substance on oxidative stress, skin aging, and cardiac hypertrophy in mice that have been aged with and without the substance.
descriptions.approach: The researchers divided the mice into six groups and gave them different combinations of the substance, vitamin C, and a control substance. They then measured various biological markers in the mice's hearts and skin tissues to compare the effects of the different groups.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A substance is evaluated for its effect on biological systems showing signs of deterioration over time, measuring changes in tissue structure, stress levels, and molecular markers of damage and repair across different treatment schedules.
descriptions.approach: Animals are exposed to a model of progressive decline, then treated either before or after the onset of decline. Tissue samples are analyzed for biochemical and structural changes, and outcomes are compared across treatment timing and control groups.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: DİJİTAL AKTİVİZM BAĞLAMINDA #DİSNEYPLUSBOYKOT HAREKETİNİN DEĞERLENDİRİLMESİ: “ATATÜRK” DİZİSİ ÖRNEĞİ

descriptions.problem: A pattern of public response to a cultural decision is analyzed to determine how it triggers collective action and shifts in public sentiment over time.
descriptions.approach: Social media content is grouped by recurring themes and mapped to underlying motivations, revealing how a specific event reactivates and redirects existing emotional and social currents.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the reaction of people on social media to a decision not to air a TV series, and compares it to other reactions to similar decisions. It predicts how people will behave when they feel strongly about an issue.
descriptions.approach: The researchers analyzed tweets on social media using a method called thematic analysis, which involves looking for patterns in the language used. They followed a procedure that involved identifying and coding the tweets, then looking for common themes and ideas.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Comparative and Stability Study of Rice Bran Oil in Nanovesicle: Conventional Niosomes and pH-Sensitive Niosomes

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the stability of a certain type of delivery system over time, comparing its performance under different conditions. It predicts the effectiveness of this system in delivering a specific compound through the skin.
descriptions.approach: The researchers varied the composition of the delivery system and the conditions it was exposed to, then measured its physical properties and performance over time. They used this data to compare the performance of two different types of delivery systems.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The performance and durability of a lipid-based delivery system are evaluated under varying environmental conditions and with different payload types, measuring how well the system maintains structural integrity and functional output over time.
descriptions.approach: A system is designed with adjustable payload concentration and environmental triggers, then monitored for size, surface charge, and payload retention across time and temperature. Performance is compared across conditions using standardized metrics of stability and transport efficiency.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: The effect of a lifestyle programme for moderate hypertriglyceridemia

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of a specific type of diet on a person's risk of cardiovascular disease, comparing the results before and after a period of intervention. It predicts that this type of diet will lower the person's risk of cardiovascular disease.
descriptions.approach: The work follows a procedure where a person is given a specific type of diet and physical activity, and their risk of cardiovascular disease is measured before and after. The results are then compared to see if the intervention was effective.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A long-term health metric is reduced through changes in daily habits and dietary patterns, with measurable improvements in multiple physiological indicators over a short intervention period.
descriptions.approach: A structured regimen limits intake of energy-dense components and increases physical activity, with daily routines focused on consistent, low-energy food sources and regular movement to shift internal balance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Modified (Ba,Sr)(Sn,Ti)O3 via hydrothermal synthesis for electrocaloric application

descriptions.problem: This work investigates how to create materials with a large change in energy when heated, high resistance to electric fields, and low energy loss when heated. It aims to find the best way to prepare these materials from a mixture of substances and analyze their properties.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use a method to mix the substances and then heat them to create a new material. They then analyze the material's properties, such as its ability to change energy when heated, its resistance to electric fields, and its energy loss when heated.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A material's response to an electric field is measured across a range of conditions to determine how effectively it can induce a reversible thermal change in a controlled environment.
descriptions.approach: A powder is synthesized with adjusted composition to control particle size and purity. The resulting bulk form is processed under reduced heat, and its thermal and electrical behavior is evaluated under varying field strengths and environmental conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Influence of humic and fulvic acids on living organisms and prospects for their application

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the impact of certain compounds on living things, comparing their effects on different types of life forms, from tiny microbe-like things to large animals and plants. It also predicts the potential benefits of these compounds for human health and the environment.
descriptions.approach: The researchers analyzed existing studies on the effects of these compounds, looking at how they affect living things at different levels (molecular, structural, and whole). They also looked at data from people living in areas with high concentrations of these compounds in their water supply.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The effect of a naturally occurring, soil-derived compound on biological systems across different life forms is assessed, particularly its influence on growth, stress resilience, and disease resistance in various life stages.
descriptions.approach: A systematic review of existing evidence is conducted, evaluating outcomes across species and environments, with emphasis on long-term health indicators and exposure to natural water sources with high concentrations of the compound.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Effect of CuO nano additive with novel punnai methyl ester in a TBC CI engine

descriptions.problem: This work aims to estimate the effect of adding a small amount of a specific material to a mixture of substances on the performance of a complex system. It predicts how this addition will change the system's behavior and optimise its efficiency.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use a combination of analysis techniques to determine the properties of the substances. They then test the system with and without the added material, comparing the results to see how the addition affects the system's performance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system's performance under varying input conditions is evaluated to determine improvements in energy conversion efficiency and reductions in harmful byproduct output.
descriptions.approach: A layered surface is applied to enhance thermal resistance. A nano-scale additive is introduced to the input medium, and the resulting operational outcomes are measured across multiple performance indicators under controlled environmental conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Control of voltage source converters under varying grid impedance in active filter applications

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the effect of changing the configuration of a power system on the stability of a control system used to mitigate local distortions in the network. It predicts how these changes will alter the performance of a specific type of control system.
descriptions.approach: The work uses data from the power system to test a control method that adjusts the phase angle of a control system to maintain stability. The method follows a procedure that involves comparing the system's performance under different conditions and optimising the phase angle to achieve the best results.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system adjusts its output to counteract distortions caused by changing network conditions, maintaining balance between detected disturbances and the system's response.
descriptions.approach: The system continuously monitors the phase relationship between input signals and the network, recalibrating its output magnitude and timing to ensure opposition to disturbances regardless of environmental shifts.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Diagnosing Fabry nephropathy: the challenge of multiple kidney disease

descriptions.problem: Estimate the likelihood of a specific condition being present in a patient based on their symptoms and medical history, but be cautious of overlapping symptoms with other conditions.
descriptions.approach: Use a combination of clinical signs, laboratory tests, and histological examination to identify the condition, and consider the possibility of co-occurrence with other conditions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of progressive organ dysfunction is assessed to determine whether a specific metabolic deficiency is present, given overlapping symptoms with other known disorders.
descriptions.approach: A computational model integrates clinical signs, laboratory biomarkers, and tissue-level abnormalities to evaluate the likelihood of a rare enzymatic deficiency, adjusting for coexisting conditions through weighted evidence from historical and diagnostic records.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Therapeutic Penetrating Keratoplasty for Severe Fungal Keratitis in a Thai Tertiary Care Center

descriptions.problem: This work aims to determine the effectiveness of a surgical procedure in treating a severe infection of the cornea, and to evaluate the outcomes of this procedure in terms of the recovery of the cornea's function and structure.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves analyzing medical records of individuals who underwent the surgery, and comparing the outcomes of those who received the treatment with those who did not. The analysis focuses on the recovery of the cornea's function and structure, and the rate of complications.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The outcome of a surgical intervention for a severe, invasive infection is assessed, including survival of the graft, preservation of the anatomical structure, and recovery of functional vision, based on clinical records and follow-up data.
descriptions.approach: A retrospective analysis is conducted using medical records to track the success of a surgical procedure over time, evaluating survival rates, structural integrity, and visual recovery in individuals with prolonged infection and surgical intervention.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Alterations to the bovine bacterial ocular surface microbiome in the context of infectious bovine keratoconjunctivitis

descriptions.problem: This study aims to characterise the microbiome of a specific surface in cattle, comparing it between healthy and diseased individuals, and estimating the types and amounts of microorganisms present. The goal is to identify which microorganisms are involved in the disease and how they relate to the health of the surface.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a three-part approach: culturing microorganisms, analysing the relative abundance of microorganisms through DNA sequencing, and using machine learning models to categorise samples as healthy or diseased based on real-time PCR data.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of microbial community composition is estimated across different health states, comparing how microbial presence and relative abundance shift under disease conditions, using clinical and environmental metadata as context.
descriptions.approach: Microbial DNA is sequenced to measure relative abundance and diversity. A statistical model is trained on quantitative molecular signals to classify samples into distinct health states based on known microbial signatures.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: The Value of Data‐driven Category Management: A Case for Teaching Data Analytics to Purchasing and Supply Management Students

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the value of using data to manage categories of goods and services, comparing different approaches to optimise supply chain performance. It predicts the benefits of data-driven decision-making in a specific field, where complex networks and relationships are involved.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves using data analytics tools and techniques to visualise and analyse data, and to classify and compare different categories of goods and services. This approach is used to inform decision-making and optimise supply chain performance in a specific field.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to evaluate and optimize decisions across a network of operational units by analyzing historical performance and financial inputs to identify patterns and improve efficiency in resource allocation.
descriptions.approach: A model processes structured input streams, applies statistical grouping to identify usage trends, and generates visual and numerical summaries to support strategic adjustments based on observed behavior and cost outcomes.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Stability of organic carbon pools and sequestration potential as affected under different agroforestry systems

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the stability of organic matter pools and the potential for these pools to be replenished in degraded areas. It compares the effects of different systems on the amount and type of organic matter in the top layers of the ground.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used data from five different systems, each involving a combination of trees and crops. They measured the density and type of organic matter at different depths and compared the results to identify the most effective system.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The stability and distribution of organic material in a landscape are assessed across different land management strategies, comparing how much and where it accumulates or depletes with depth and over time.
descriptions.approach: A model evaluates the amount of organic material in various layers of the land, tracking changes over time and across treatments, using measurements of microbial activity and chemical reactivity as indicators of long-term retention.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Application of Flipped Classroom in Vocational Medical Education Research

descriptions.problem: The effectiveness of a new instructional model is evaluated by measuring changes in student performance and hands-on skill development over time, using data from learning outcomes and practical assessments.
descriptions.approach: Students engage with instructional content before class, then participate in structured, guided activities during sessions. Performance is monitored and compared across groups using consistent evaluation criteria and longitudinal data collection.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the effectiveness of a new method for training students in a specific field, comparing the outcomes of students who use this method to those who do not. It also predicts how well students will perform in practical skills and optimizes the use of technology in training.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use data from students who have used this new method to train students, analyzing the results to explain how the method impacts student performance and practical skills.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Suggested Scoring Scale for Nurse's Self as a Role Model in Health Promotion in Primary Health Care Centers

descriptions.problem: This work estimates and predicts the level of self-perception as a role model for health promotion among a specific group, comparing it to their health practices and social characteristics. It aims to explain the relationship between these factors and provide recommendations for improving health promotion programs.
descriptions.approach: The study uses a direct interview approach to collect data from a selected group, analyzing the results using statistical tests to identify associations and correlations between variables.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A scoring system is developed to evaluate how strongly individuals perceive themselves as effective models for promoting healthy behaviors in community settings.
descriptions.approach: Data from a group of practitioners is collected and analyzed using statistical tests to assess associations between personal characteristics and self-reported health behavior influence. A scale is created and validated through repeated measurement to ensure consistency and reliability.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: The effect of the global climate change on the vitality of viticulture in Russia

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the impact of global changes on the productivity of a specific type of agriculture in Russia, comparing the effects of rising temperatures over a 40-year period.
descriptions.approach: The researchers analyzed statistical data on temperature records and solar radiation levels to draw conclusions and propose measures for improving the productivity of this type of agriculture in a changing climate.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The average temperature and solar exposure over time in specific geographic regions are analyzed to assess how environmental conditions have shifted and how these changes may affect crop productivity and regional agricultural outcomes.
descriptions.approach: Historical temperature and solar radiation data are compared across regions and time periods. Trends are identified and mapped to regional patterns, then used to infer how current and future environmental conditions may influence agricultural performance.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

topic_name: Advancements in PLL and VCO Technologies
title: Selected Issues Causing Meta-stability in Digital Circuits and Approaches to Avoiding Them

descriptions.problem: This work identifies and explains issues that can cause problems in the design of complex systems that process information in a series of steps. It estimates the likelihood of these problems occurring and compares them to known data.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves analyzing the relationships between different components of the system and identifying the most critical factors that contribute to these problems. It uses a systematic procedure to evaluate and optimize the design of the system.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system's behavior is observed to exhibit prolonged uncertainty when inputs arrive out of sequence or with insufficient time between transitions, leading to inconsistent output states over time.
descriptions.approach: A timing rule is applied to align input events with a shared time reference, and a switching mechanism is introduced to route signals only when both input and reference conditions are met, minimizing delays and ensuring consistent state transitions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Cholesterol lowering acitivity and vasorelaxant effect of ethanol extract Piper aduncum leaves in hypercholesterolemic wistar kyoto rats

descriptions.problem: This study aims to estimate the effect of a plant extract on two key health metrics: blood pressure and fat levels in a specific animal model. The researchers compare the effects of different doses of the extract to a standard treatment and a control group.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use a controlled experiment with multiple groups of animals, each receiving a different treatment: a standard diet, a high-fat diet, a medication, or one of three doses of the plant extract. The experiment involves measuring key health metrics over time.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A substance is evaluated for its ability to reduce lipid accumulation and improve blood vessel relaxation in a model of elevated lipid levels and increased blood pressure.
descriptions.approach: The substance is administered orally over a set period to animals on a high-fat diet. Blood samples and pressure measurements are collected to compare lipid and vascular responses across different doses and against a standard treatment.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Experience of successful use of intense pulsed light in the treatment of Shamberg patients

descriptions.problem: This research aims to estimate the effectiveness of a specific method in improving a cosmetic condition, which is a common issue in a particular medical condition. The goal is to compare the results of this method with the current standard of care and identify the most optimal approach.
descriptions.approach: The research uses a specific device to emit a high-intensity beam of light, and the settings and protocol are carefully controlled to achieve the best results. The outcome is evaluated by comparing the initial and follow-up results, and the findings are used to explain the success of the method.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A dynamic response to a chronic skin condition is assessed over time to evaluate changes in lesion appearance and stability after an intervention.
descriptions.approach: A consistent protocol is applied to a patient's skin, and observations are recorded at defined intervals to track the evolution of lesion intensity and resolution patterns.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: An enhanced transcription factor repressilator that buffers stochasticity and entrains to an erratic external circadian signal

descriptions.problem: This research aims to understand how complex systems maintain patterns in their behavior despite random fluctuations and unpredictable external influences. It seeks to optimize the dynamics of a network that transforms internal and external inputs into a consistent response.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using computer software to model the behavior of a network that takes in concentrations of key components and produces patterns in their behavior. An artificial neural network is used to efficiently search for solutions to this complex challenge.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to maintain a stable, repeating pattern of molecular activity despite random fluctuations and unpredictable external signals that vary in timing and presence.
descriptions.approach: A model maps internal molecular states to their rates of change using a learned function that adjusts dynamically. The system is refined by simulating molecular behavior under noise and variable input timing, selecting configurations that best preserve the desired repeating pattern.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A review of foot-and-mouth disease in Ethiopia: epidemiological aspects, economic implications, and control strategies

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the economic impact of a contagious viral illness on livestock farmers, predicts the effectiveness of control measures, and compares the situation in Ethiopia to the global situation. It aims to explain the importance of understanding the genetic diversity of the virus for effective control strategies.
descriptions.approach: The procedure involves comparing data from Ethiopia with global data, using molecular investigation to understand the genetic diversity of the virus, and applying control measures such as vaccinations to prevent illness.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the economic impact of recurring outbreaks in animal populations by analyzing trade restrictions and productivity losses linked to viral spread across regions.
descriptions.approach: It uses genetic variation data from circulating pathogens to match vaccine effectiveness, then models economic outcomes under different containment scenarios based on regional infection patterns and movement rates.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Green Synthesis and Characterization of Nano Silver Doped Nano Hydroxyapatite (nAg-nHAP) using OcimumTenuiflorum Leaf Extract and Sea Shell - A New Approach

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the properties of a material made from calcium oxide, which is derived from a natural source, and optimizes its structure by adding a metal dopant. The goal is to create a material with specific properties, such as a certain ratio of calcium to phosphorus.
descriptions.approach: The researcher starts by heating a natural source to high temperatures to extract the calcium oxide. They then mix the calcium oxide with a chemical solution to create a new material, and add a metal dopant to it. The material is then heated again to create a powder, which is analyzed using various techniques to confirm its structure and properties.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A material composed of calcium, phosphorus, and oxygen is prepared with a controlled ratio of calcium to phosphorus, and a small amount of a metal component is introduced to modify its structure and properties.
descriptions.approach: Calcium is extracted from a natural inorganic source and reacted with phosphorus under buffered conditions to form a crystalline structure. The metal component is introduced via a plant-based reagent, then combined with the structure and heated to stabilize the final form.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Development of mining and geological information system in the present-day situation in the Russian mining industry

descriptions.problem: This work aims to improve the efficiency and safety of a complex process involving the exploration, design, and operation of a facility that extracts valuable resources from the earth. It estimates the distribution of useful and harmful components of these resources and assesses the risk level of different design solutions.
descriptions.approach: The approach involves using 3D models to analyze the process, determining patterns of resource distribution, and selecting the most efficient technologies and equipment. This is done to optimize the process and explain the economic efficiency of different design solutions.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system estimates the spatial distribution and behavior of underground resources to support decision-making across exploration, planning, and operations using 3D representations of subsurface structures and material properties.
descriptions.approach: It integrates historical and real-time observations into a unified 3D model, simulates various development sequences, evaluates risks and costs, and selects optimal operational strategies based on predictive outcomes and performance metrics.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Effects of pork sausage on intestinal microecology and metabolism in mice

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the effects of a certain type of food on the health of small animals, comparing their gut health and bodily chemicals to a control group. It aims to explain how this food might contribute to certain diseases.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a combination of DNA sequencing and chemical analysis to compare the gut health and bodily chemicals of the animals that ate this food to those that didn't. They looked for patterns and changes in the data to understand the impact of this food on the animals' health.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The impact of a specific dietary component on the composition of internal microbial populations and the biochemical changes in bodily fluids is assessed using biological samples from living organisms.
descriptions.approach: A model analyzes patterns in microbial abundance and biochemical signatures across different dietary conditions, identifying key biochemical indicators linked to shifts in microbial diversity and physiological responses.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PARENTS' OVERPROTECTIVE BEHAVIOR AND STUDENTS' SELF-ADJUSTMENT

descriptions.problem: This study investigates the relationship between how much control one group of people has over another group and how well the second group can make decisions on their own. It aims to understand if there is a connection between how much control is exercised and the ability to self-regulate.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a survey to collect data from this group of people, which is a type of data that can be easily verified. They then analyzed the data to see if there is a linear relationship between the amount of control and the ability to self-regulate.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A linear relationship is estimated between an individual's ability to adapt to changing environments and the level of control they experience in their daily interactions with caregivers.
descriptions.approach: A statistical model tests whether observed data points align along a straight line using a correlation threshold; if the deviation from linearity exceeds a set significance level, the relationship is deemed non-linear.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Clinical characterisation of women with persistent genital arousal disorder: the iPGAD-study

descriptions.problem: This study estimates the characteristics of a rare condition in women, where they experience prolonged genital sensations without desire or stimulation. It compares these women to healthy controls to identify differences in their mental and physical health.
descriptions.approach: The researchers compared 26 women with this condition to 26 age-matched healthy controls, using a variety of investigations including physical and mental examinations, and imaging tests. They also gathered detailed information about the women's experiences and triggers.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A pattern of persistent sensory disturbances in specific body regions is assessed and compared to a control group with similar demographics. The goal is to identify associations between these disturbances and co-occurring mental health conditions, lifestyle factors, and physical manifestations.
descriptions.approach: Participants undergo detailed interviews and physical evaluations. Data on sensory experiences, environmental triggers, relief factors, and mental health comorbidities are collected and analyzed across groups using statistical comparison and pattern recognition.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: 4 Minds at Rest: Characterizing Clinical and Demographic Sources of Variability in Spontaneous Cognition During the Resting State.

descriptions.problem: This work estimates and explains the characteristics of people's mental states when they are not actively engaged in tasks, using data from audio recordings of participants' verbal descriptions of their internal experiences. It compares these characteristics across different groups of people, including those with different ages and levels of creativity.
descriptions.approach: The researchers used a think-aloud technique, where participants verbalized their internal experiences while performing a simple task, and then analyzed the content and dynamic patterns of their verbalizations using automated text analysis and external coders.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The system estimates how individual differences in cognitive patterns emerge during periods of unstructured mental activity, relating these patterns to traits like creativity, age, and emotional expression based on spoken content.
descriptions.approach: It analyzes spoken narratives in real time, extracting linguistic features such as word choice, flow, and topic shifts, then maps these to known behavioral traits using automated and human-reviewed coding to detect consistent patterns across individuals.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Phytochemical Analysis of Extractive Substances Extracted by Different Methods from the Underground Part of Aconitum Septentrionale L., and the Development of Cream-Gels Based on Them

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the composition of certain compounds in plant parts, compares the amounts of these compounds in different plant parts, and optimizes the process of isolating these compounds from the plant parts. It uses data from the plant parts' physical properties and the amounts of compounds found in them.
descriptions.approach: The researchers use a combination of physical analysis and sequential processing to isolate the compounds from the plant parts. They compare the results of different isolation methods and develop a formula for creating a new product based on the isolated compounds.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: The relative abundance of specific molecular compounds is measured across different processing conditions, and the resulting formulations are evaluated for consistency and performance in delivering a desired therapeutic effect.
descriptions.approach: Plant material is processed under varying time and temperature regimes to yield different compound profiles. The resulting mixtures are combined with a base to form a stable, deliverable form, and their physical and functional properties are systematically assessed.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: Arvon: A Heterogeneous System-in-Package Integrating FPGA and DSP Chiplets for Versatile Workload Acceleration

descriptions.problem: This research estimates the performance of a system that accelerates a wide range of tasks, such as processing signals in communication systems or training artificial neural networks. It predicts the performance of the system based on the characteristics of the tasks and the hardware used.
descriptions.approach: The system uses multiple hardware components to work together, with each component optimized for a specific type of task. The components are connected using a high-speed communication system that allows them to exchange data efficiently.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

descriptions.problem: A system is designed to accelerate diverse computational tasks by dynamically distributing them across programmable and specialized processing units, using real-time data flow and performance feedback to adapt execution based on input characteristics and resource availability.
descriptions.approach: Tasks are partitioned and routed between a flexible processing unit and dedicated high-throughput units based on data patterns and computational demands, using a high-bandwidth, low-latency interconnect to synchronize and transfer data efficiently.
descriptions.author: nicolas-maman

title: A dataset of water boundaries of Hulun Lake from 1975 to 2018

descriptions.problem: This work estimates the spatial and temporal distribution of a large body of liquid over time, using data from images taken from space. It aims to provide a long-term record of changes in the size and shape of this body, to support research on its impact on the environment and economy.
